segs.t: If you run a consumables brand, selling supplements, skincare, haircare, pet food, you're in the right niche.
The only problem that you do not know what to go ahead and do to skill your brand to seven or eight figures per month
is you do not understand how your attention works.
You don't have the right frameworks in order to go ahead and skill, because everyone thinks it's just front-end acquisition.
But it's your back-end that's important.
How are you going to keep people as long as possible? How are you going to retain them?
How is your supply chain looking? How is your operations looking? How is your team doing?
In order to go ahead and build a brand to the stage of what we've done with our own brand
is literally having the front-end and the back-end locked in.
And that mostly comes down when I've seen it with multiple operators is that their systems are broken.
They're all literally doing everything themselves or they have only outsourced a little bit of their business
because they're so greedy on having that little extra margin in their pocket
instead of reinvesting that into their business to skill ten times more.
If you're having this issue or you can feel that you're going to not be able to skill as hard as possible,
make sure to reach out to me, send me a DM and I want to see if you are fit in order to join our community
or work 101 with us in order to skill your brand.
